purpose: Turns any failure in adding, storing or showing a picture into one sentence that names the cause and what the person can do next.
namedChanges: 0.1.1. peerDependencies picture-shrink and picture-upload are "^0.1.0 || ^0.2.0" (main holds 0.2.0 of both; "^0.1.0" stopped npm install with ERESOLVE); src/peerRanges.test.ts checks every @kaigilb peer range against the sibling unit's version
New code, written for GitHubStandardPictures: pictureFailure(e, words?) with eleven kinds in a fixed order, DEFAULT_PICTURE_FAILURE_WORDS, and PictureFailureNote with pictureErrors.css

host.replaces: nothing in a source app (new code); optional: the sentences and next steps by kind, in the app's language

library.title: Picture error messages
library.note: Turns a thrown value into words; it does not catch, log or retry (retry is save-queue). For the access-denied screen take refusal-detail.
